A special ability of <c:ffff00>legs<c> <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> that activates
automatically.

Some traits are always in {{effect}} during a <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c>,
while others only take {{effect}} when certain
conditions are met.

Many of them strengthen the <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> equipped
with the {{part}}.
